papers.title: Properties of Jet electrodeposition Nickel Coating on TC4 Alloy Prepared by Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor surface wear resistance and low hardness of titanium alloy materials formed by selective laser melting (SLM) technology, a new method of preparing bright nickel protective coating by jet electrodeposition was proposed in this paper. The surface morphology of the coatings was characterized by field emission scanning electron microscopy. The microhardness tester, scratch tester, and friction and wear tester were used to analyze the adhesion, hardness, and wear resistance of the coatings. The results indicated that the current density has an important effect on the properties of the coatings; as the current density increases, the surface flatness gradually increases and then decreases. When the current density is 120 A/dm2, the microhardness of the coatings reaches 548 HV, and the adhesion strength also reaches 30.4 N. Compared with the surface of titanium alloy, the surface of the coating has better wear resistance, and the surface is more complete after friction and wear test. The wear mechanism is transformed from microscopic grinding to smearing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM钛合金的表面涂层处理，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface coating of SLM Ti alloy via jet electrodeposition, but does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善SLM钛合金表面耐磨性和硬度
summary_zh.method: 采用喷射电沉积在SLM TC4表面制备镍涂层
summary_zh.result: 电流密度120 A/dm²时涂层硬度548 HV，结合力30.4 N，耐磨性提升
summary_zh.validation: SEM形貌、显微硬度、划痕和摩擦磨损测试

summary_en.motivation: To improve the poor surface wear resistance and low hardness of titanium alloy components fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A bright nickel protective coating was prepared on SLM TC4 alloy via jet electrodeposition, and the effect of current density on coating properties was investigated.
summary_en.result: At a current density of 120 A/dm², the coating achieved a microhardness of 548 HV and an adhesion strength of 30.4 N, with significantly improved wear resistance.
summary_en.validation: Surface morphology, microhardness, scratch adhesion, and friction-wear tests were conducted.

papers.title: Comparison of Mechanical Properties and Energy Absorption of Sheet-Based and Strut-Based Gyroid Cellular Structures with Graded Densities
papers.abstract: Bio-inspired functionally graded cellular materials (FGCM) have improved performance in energy absorption compared with a uniform cellular material (UCM). In this work, sheet-based and strut-based gyroid cellular structures with graded densities are designed and manufactured by stereo-lithography (SLA). For comparison, uniform structures are also designed and manufactured, and the graded structures are generated with different gradients. The mechanical behaviors of these structures under compressive loads are investigated. Furthermore, the anisotropy and effective elastic modulus of sheet-based and strut-based unit gyroid cellular structures are estimated by a numerical homogenization method. On the one hand, it is found from the numerical results that the sheet-based gyroid tends to be isotropic, and the elastic modulus of sheet-based gyroid is larger than the strut-based gyroid at the same volume fraction. On the other hand, the graded cellular structure has novel deformation and mechanical behavior. The uniform structure exhibits overall deformation and collapse behavior, whereas the graded cellular structure shows layer-by-layer deformation and collapse behavior. Furthermore, the uniform sheet-based gyroid is not only stiffer but also better in energy absorption capacity than the uniform strut-based gyroid structure. Moreover, the graded cellular structures have better energy absorption capacity than the uniform structures. These significant findings indicate that sheet-based gyroid cellular structure with graded densities have potential applications in various industrial applications, such as in crashworthiness.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了基于片状和杆状螺旋结构的梯度密度多孔材料的力学性能，但未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, fatigue testing, LPBF fabrication, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较片状与杆状螺旋梯度多孔结构的力学性能与能量吸收能力。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLA制造不同梯度密度的片状和杆状螺旋结构，进行压缩实验和数值均匀化分析。
summary_zh.result: 片状螺旋结构更各向同性、刚度更大，梯度结构具有逐层变形和更好的能量吸收能力。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩实验与数值均匀化方法验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical properties and energy absorption of sheet-based and strut-based gyroid cellular structures with graded densities.
summary_en.method: Sheet-based and strut-based gyroid structures with uniform and graded densities were fabricated via stereolithography (SLA) and tested under compression, with numerical homogenization for elastic modulus and anisotropy.
summary_en.result: Sheet-based gyroids exhibit higher isotropy and stiffness; graded structures show layer-by-layer collapse and superior energy absorption compared to uniform ones.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and numerical homogenization.

papers.title: PENINGKATAN KOMPETENSI GURU MENGGUNAKAN TEKNOLOGI INFORMASI DAN KOMUNIKASI (TIK) DALAM PEMBELAJARAN DI SEKOLAH DASAR MELALUI SUPERVISI KLINIS
papers.abstract: This research is motivated by the demands of an era full of technology so that the learning process must shift from conventional learning to active learning that utilizes ICT in the learning process. The facts found in the field indicate that teachers do not use ICT in the learning process for difficult reasons, teachers do not have the competence to use ICT, and facilities that are less available. The purpose of this study is to improve teacher competence using information and communication technology in learning through clinical supervision. This research is a classroom action research which includes the stages of planning, implementation, observation, and reflection. This research was carried out in the target schools of Pasir Penyu sub-district starting March 13 to April 30 2019 against 10 elementary school teachers. Data analysis using observation sheets that observe the actions of teachers using ICT in the learning process. The results showed an increase in teacher competency using ICT in the learning process with the percentage of the first cycle amounting to 57% with the medium category being 83% which included a very high category.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于教师使用信息技术能力的教育研究，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about teacher ICT competency improvement in elementary schools, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics content.

summary_zh.motivation: 教师缺乏使用信息技术进行教学的能力
summary_zh.method: 通过临床监督进行课堂行动研究
summary_zh.result: 教师使用ICT的能力从57%提高到83%

summary_en.motivation: Teachers lack competence in using ICT for active learning in elementary schools.
summary_en.method: Classroom action research with clinical supervision cycles (planning, implementation, observation, reflection).
summary_en.result: Teacher ICT competency increased from 57% (medium) to 83% (very high) after two cycles.
summary_en.validation: Data collected via observation sheets on teacher actions during ICT use.
